comments.body:
What do you get paid per game — and what's actually included?

Rates for this work are all over the map. So: what's your number, what's the format, and does the venue cover your tab?

We'll go first. $150 for a 90-minute set, buzzers and PA included, venue covers nothing extra.
I run 1hr shows for $120, host-owned PA. Venue covers nothing, I bring my own screen too.

replies.body: That's close to what I charge up north too — good to see it's not just a local thing.
